notes: Only one *the* is written for חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה and the rectum is rendered anarthrously as *of Manasseh*, so rule 29's fronting gives that *the* to the article on the name; rule 29's proper-name paragraph forbids setting it aside as lexicalized. The competing supplied-*the* reading is named in the unit note.
The two assimilated articles supplied as bracketed tokens take their written *the*s under rule 12.
שֵׁבֶט is rendered attributively in *half tribe*, so no *of* is written for it (rule 28).
